methodology.pintailPlacement: container on the docker host, --cpus=8 --memory=8g (same as MySQL/ClickHouse), 4 GiB per-query memory ceiling
methodology.iterations: warm: 2 warmup + 15 measured; cold: 5 distinct memo-cold variants; MySQL baseline reused from 2026-09-24T19:09:20.650Z
methodology.statistics: median, mean, p95, stddev, ci95, and all raw samples

references.clickhouseFinal: ReplacingMergeTree, final=1 (merge-on-read duty, query cache off)

methodology.pintailSettledMemo: bare full-table aggregates on a settled replica (empty memtable) are served from a manifest-generation-keyed exact result memo; any ingest invalidates it by construction. ClickHouse ships a query cache too, disabled by default and TTL-stale; pintail's is provably fresh, so it stays on.

gate.scope: memo-dashboard latency, not raw engine speed
